variables.name: ADMIN_USERNAME
variables.description: Username for the single protected admin account.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password for the single protected admin account. Change the first-run placeholder before real deployment.

variables.name: SESSION_SECRET
variables.description: Secret key used to sign admin session cookies.

variables.name: DB_PATH
variables.description: Path to the primary SQLite database used for the login failure ledger.

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: HTTP port the application listens on.

variables.name: TRUST_PROXY
variables.description: Whether to trust X-Forwarded-For and X-Real-IP headers from a known reverse proxy.
